title: RIFT — A browser-based MMORPG base, now open source.
author: manadamc
selftext:
RIFT is an open-source foundation for building 3D MMORPGs that run directly in the browser, built with Three.js on the client and an authoritative Node.js + WebSocket server. It includes a working reference game with four classes, PvE combat, an ability system, monster AI, a map editor, and a procedural world — but the real goal is to be a base other developers can build on.

I'm publishing the base on GitHub and will be pushing frequent updates to the mechanics, so if you want to follow along, give it a Star to keep track of what's coming.

The game UI and content are currently in Brazilian Portuguese, but an English translation is already in progress — both the README and in-game text are being localised.

This is a public-use base. Anyone can use it, fork it, and contribute to its construction. Contributions are welcome at all levels — fixes, new classes, rendering improvements, better docs, translation help, or experiments.

REPOSITORY LINK: [https://github.com/macantovitz/RIFT-MMMORPG-Lite](https://github.com/macantovitz/RIFT-MMMORPG-Lite)
